name: app-lilac-daily-challenge-app-with-3d-shapes-and-pastel-plan-cards
title: Lilac Daily Challenge App with 3D Shapes
whatItIs: A lilac page with a phone showing 'Hello, Sandra', a purple Daily challenge card with 3D orange, yellow and grey shapes, a pill date strip with Wed selected in black, Your plan cards (orange Yoga Group, blue Balance with 3D stones, pink social icons) and a pill tab bar, with a footer band and website.
whatItMeans: Bright 3D toy-like shapes and pastel cards make fitness feel playful, and the pill date strip is a friendly detail.
techniques: Pill-shaped date strip with one black selected day
Pastel card colours by class type
Black pill tab bar with a white active button
Lilac page and a darker footer band

vocabulary.definition: A row of day pills with the current day highlighted.
Chunky rounded 3D objects used as illustration.
A colour-coded card for a scheduled activity.
